setup_sqls: CREATE TABLE tenk1 AS SELECT g AS unique1, g%2 AS two, g%10 AS ten, g%20 AS twenty, g%100 AS hundred FROM generate_series(0,1999) g

CREATE INDEX tenk1_hundred ON tenk1(hundred)

query: SELECT sum(c) FROM (SELECT t0.unique1, (SELECT count(*) FROM tenk1 t2 JOIN tenk1 t1 ON t1.unique1 = t2.hundred + t0.ten WHERE t1.twenty = t0.ten) AS c FROM tenk1 t0 WHERE t0.unique1 < 100) s
